issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Files
issues.why: The spec references 'lifecycle-10-research-lifecycle.mmd' and 'lifecycle-top-research.mmd' as normative sources, but these files are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the .mmd file contents in the module or inline the Mermaid source code within the overview files.

issues.title: Undefined Domain Registry
issues.why: The contract for TOP-RES entries requires 'domains' to be an array of spec module relpaths, but there is no validation logic or list provided to verify if a path is valid.
issues.fix: Add a regex pattern or a reference to a master module list to the 'domains' property in the JSON schema.

issues.title: Vague Verification Clauses
issues.why: AC-RESEARCH-05 (Forward-only updates) lacks a 'Verifies' clause and a concrete automated check, relying on manual PR review which contradicts the 'AI coder' requirement.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verifies' clause citing the SemVer invariant and provide a script snippet to check for breaking schema changes.
